## Product
NexAgent OS runs an SME from one WhatsApp number: quotes, job cards, invoicing, stock, payroll and leads. Eight modules (M1–M8). No extra apps.

## Pricing — one plan only. Not VAT registered: no VAT is added.
- Free trial: 14-day free trial. We cover the setup. You only pay if you choose to continue after the trial, and nothing is charged automatically. The trial simply ends unless you say yes. We'll give you the price before your trial starts.
- Founder (first 10 clients): founders save 33% on the monthly and 67% on setup (60 jobs and 300 chats a month), locked for 12 months, then the standard monthly price at that time, with 30 days' notice. After that, increases match the percentage rise in our costs, with 30 days' written notice.
- Included every month: 300 AI chats and 60 jobs (a job is one quote-to-paid cycle).
- Top-ups: one top-up pack adds +250 chats AND +50 jobs, one charge on the next invoice. No chat-only or job-only top-ups.
- Soft limit: usage is tracked per workshop and shown on the dashboard, with alerts at 80% and 100%. At 100% the AI keeps replying (never cut off) and the client is asked to top up. Usage resets monthly.
- WhatsApp messaging fees are included.
